correctness.rationale: The contraction is explicitly defined by a proper inward shift, a weighted path metric, and finite-radius neighborhoods. The image and its neighborhoods have at most \(n\) connected components; the unbounded direction set is preserved for t<1; and the bound \(\rho(t)/w(t)=t(1-t)\) proves convergence to the canonical target at t=1. The local continuity argument uses the finite graph core, finitely many rays, and locally uniform bounds on bounded ray portions and tail starts within one direction class.
